versions.changelog:
- Generalized from WhatsApp-only to any text-message channel: SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, RCS, and in-app chat.
- Formatting guidance now assumes plain text by default, and says which channels accept *bold*/_italic_ instead of assuming WhatsApp markup everywhere.
- Adds SMS length guidance: Tamil script forces UCS-2 at 70 characters per segment, Tanglish stays in GSM-7 at 160, so prefer Tanglish on SMS unless the user wrote in Tamil script first.
- Renamed from tamil-whatsapp to tamil-messaging. The old slug remains a redirect and existing installs keep working.

- Handles code-mixed Tamil + English messages: English words the user code-switches stay in English instead of being translated into literary Tamil.
- Tolerates non-standard Tanglish spelling (vanakkam/vanakam/vannakam, enna/yenna) by matching on sound; never corrects the user's spelling.
- Replies in spoken register rather than literary Tamil, and stay chat-length instead of email-shaped.
- Adds WhatsApp formatting rules: *bold*/_italic_ instead of Markdown, no headings or tables, 3-4 lines per message.
- Adds number, money and time conventions: lakh/crore, digits for rupee amounts, spoken time forms.
- Adds Ayudha Pooja greeting and a few more common phrases.

- Initial release of the tamil-whatsapp skill.
- Handles Tamil and Tanglish WhatsApp messages with transliteration and cultural greetings.
- Provides bilingual responses and polite language features tailored for Tamil Nadu users.
- Includes common phrases, respectful terms, and festival greetings in both Tamil and Tanglish.
